# OpenCode reference data

Synthetic session and 83 reference API/mutation cases generated by the original
Python implementation at upstream commit `b5894dae5feaf13947c2d49a34f91b088cde60ec`.
The original code is MIT licensed. There are no user conversations in these files.

Cases cover message/tool/reasoning/error/system/compaction edit previews, both
cut directions, message and part deletion, and pagination with and without
service entries. The two backup JSON files were written by the Python engine.
Rust tests consume these fixtures directly; Python is not a test dependency.
